info.title: Strand API
info.description: Work management: projects, issues, sprints, releases, automation.

devSecret.name: x-dev-secret
devSecret.description: Dev login only (AUTH_DEV); pair with x-dev-user

patch.summary: Patch a user (Entra deactivates with active=false)

get.summary: List projects with star flag and open-issue count

post.summary: Create a project with default statuses

get.summary: Project with workflow, fields, releases, templates, rules and sprints

post.summary: Mark a release shipped; unfinished work moves to another release
Complete a sprint; unfinished work moves to another sprint or the backlog

moveTo.description: Sprint that receives unfinished work (null = backlog)

get.summary: List a project's issues in backlog order (keyset-paginated)

parameters.name: sprint
parameters.description: Sprint id, or "none" for the backlog

post.summary: Create an issue (key and rank are assigned by the server)

id.description: Client-chosen id: lets the app keep its local id, and makes a retried create a conflict instead of a duplicate

get.summary: Issue with links, watchers, comments, activity, work logs, attachments and children

patch.summary: Update issue fields. Send If-Match: <version> to reject stale edits (409). Workflow transitions are enforced.

get.summary: Search issues across projects (text, key like PAY-12, or filters); newest first, keyset-paginated

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text or an issue key

get.summary: Open issues assigned to me, due soonest first
Counts by status, assignee and type; created in the last 7 days; overdue
My saved views plus shared ones

post.summary: Register an attachment; returns a presigned uploadUrl to PUT the bytes to (5 min)

delete.summary: Delete an attachment and its file

post.summary: One-time import of a browser forge:v1 state (reducer v4). Admin only; existing project keys are skipped.
